summary: Couch Investor gives his weekly portfolio update: the portfolio fell 4% on the week against a 0.56% S&P drop, but remains up 20% year to date versus 10.8% for the index. He previews a heavy earnings week, Apple and Palantir on Monday, Shopify on Tuesday, and notes he was featured on the All-In podcast and that one of his posts was misinterpreted. The headline move is a full exit from Rubrik for about a 90% gain: a good company growing above 20%, but at a PEG of 12.1 and about 10x sales a couple of years out on a $25.7B market cap against $1.54B trailing revenue, he calls it stretched and will redeploy into cheaper names he already owns, keeping Rubrik on coverage for a possible re-entry. On Reddit he stays wait-and-see, keeping a small position down 44.2% and refusing to add until a catalyst such as an AI data-licensing deal appears, with support near $88 and resistance at $153/$171. He also floats closing a PayPal bull spread, worth over $17K, to add to undervalued names under pressure, runs through his recurring technical-analysis buy zones (Alphabet 270-285, Meta 600-625, Broadcom, CoreWeave, AMD, Rocket Lab) and closes on prediction markets. Calls: RBRK SELL (full exit); RDDT UNCERTAIN, no firm call.
title: I Sold an Entire Position This Week. Here’s What I’m Doing With the Money
